nodes.text:
$BTC DOMINANCE 🚨

Consider Bitcoin Dominance directly to relate with alts because this is the only way that can give us hint about Altseason. 

Currently, It is getting weeker & i'm not expecting  it to grow aggressively. There are two scenarios that can kick BTC.D again to the downwards, which means that people will be taking out money from BTC & then they'll invest in Alts.

➡️Scenario 1 : If it pumps from here then alts will bleed more. The 59%-60% is the zone which can kick it to the downwards & we'll see a reversal from it.

➡️Scenario 2 : Reversal from the current zone to the downwards as i preview in my chart.

I'm confident about the 1st scenario with much reasonable analysis & if 2nd scenario proved to be true, then it'll work as a cherry on the cake.

$BTC

As i previously mentioned in my BTC update, I think that 88k-90k is the very strong range & we'll possibly again witness the reversal from the given range.

If USDT.D went as per my analysis & make a triple top & dumps, then Bitcoin will surely show reversal from our mentioned ranges. All depends of USD.D for now.

I'm longing Bitcoin with just 2x leverage at the CMP, with the SL to $86.5k, I took low leverage as a backup, just in case if i need to expand my SL if situation comes, because i'm watching $85k also as the area of reversal. I'll update you the same if we need to.
